description: Reviewed npm audit exceptions for the dependency-audit gate. scripts/audit-dependencies.mjs fails on every high or critical advisory except the entries here; an entry that no longer matches a reported advisory fails as stale, so the list only shrinks and a closed upstream fix cannot leave a permanent waiver behind. Every entry names the advisory, the accepted-exposure rationale, and the tracking issue with the removal condition.

exceptions.reason: Stack-exhaustion denial of service via deeply nested brace patterns (CVE-2026-93687), affecting every release through 3.0.3 with no patched version and an upstream repository inactive since 2025-01. Accepted risk: braces reaches this tree only through build- and lint-time dev tooling (tailwindcss via chokidar/fast-glob/micromatch, eslint-plugin-boundaries via micromatch), parses only this repository's own glob configuration rather than attacker-controlled input, and never ships in the client bundle, so the worst case is a crashed build or lint worker. Remove once an official patched braces release lands or the Tailwind v4 plus import/no-restricted-paths migration removes braces from the tree.
